; Process the queued command unless the sound gate is set, enable tonal channels, resolve channel ownership, then visit seven $20-byte track records. Only records with bit 7 active are stepped. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; When flag $20 is set, interpolate from base timer to target timer over the note duration; otherwise copy the base timer. Volume movement and packed envelope decoding follow. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Advance a rate counter and move current volume toward the low nibble of the target. Preserve duty bits when composing the APU control byte. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Select an envelope pointer and alternate low/high nibbles using the envelope cursor. Special bytes restart, hold or terminate envelope progress; scale the selected nibble by current volume before composing the control nibble. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Clear suppression on the four background tracks, then mark physical channels claimed by the three foreground tracks. Foreground ownership suppresses competing background writes; a special release case clears hold flags. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Map the channel nibble to a background $20-byte record and set its suppression bit. Y addresses the flags field. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Shift/add unsigned eight-bit operands in sound scratch into a sixteen-bit product, preserving caller Y on the stack. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Restoring division of a sixteen-bit numerator by an eight-bit divisor. Used to distribute a pitch difference over a note duration; a zero divisor is not guarded here. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Select a signed modulation stream and add or subtract its entry from the base timer. Pitch-slide mode feeds the previous interpolated pitch back into the base. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Mask a command to five bits, look up its handler and call through the scratch pointer. The special stop command silences the track and removes a return frame, escaping stream parsing. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Read the track stream through its pointer. Values at least $E0 select commands; note values index the timer table after transposition. Optional slide targets and duration bytes advance the stream pointer and reset envelope/time cursors. This is the exact duplicate sound block; natural selection of this copy remains unresolved.

; Compute tilemap_base + 16*tile_row into the cell pointer, retaining the high-byte carry.
; Select descriptor 3 and draw rows 6 through 29. Row-to-nametable conversion wraps after fifteen metatile rows.

; Draw rows 0..29 from the column pointer, using the direct PPU service C0CF. The caller must provide a safe rendering interval. C0CC instead queues a metatile; these interfaces are not interchangeable. Advance tile_column after the column.
; Compute 24*tile_row + tilemap_base with sixteen-bit carries into tilemap_row_pointer. This layout differs from the sixteen-column tilemap helper.
; Read pointer[tile_row] into metatile_id for the direct column renderer.
; Read tilemap_row_pointer[tile_column] into metatile_id.
